description: Phillip (Phil) Jones identifies himself as a retired Air Force colonel who served as deputy A5 at U.S. CENTAF at Shaw Air Force Base during the September 11 attacks. He recalls watching television at work as the first and second planes hit, then sending office staff and conference attendees home because he feared their headquarters might be a target. Jones describes coordinating support for personnel in Egypt and arranging military transport for them and conference participants from the UAE after commercial flights stopped. He says he worked on transportation for forces deploying to the Middle East and had no day off for about 90 days, until around Thanksgiving. Jones closes by remembering his friend Dwayne Williams, an Army major he had been stationed with in Egypt, who perished; this is a personal recollection, not a claim that Jones was at an attack site. The interview was recorded on September 11, 2026; the collection identifies its subject event as the September 11 terrorist attacks of 2001.
